item.description: Here's your Woodchuck Weather. Tonight, skies range from mostly cloudy to overcast with low temperatures between thirty-two and thirty-eight degrees and only a slight chance of precipitation. Tomorrow brings mostly cloudy to partly cloudy conditions and high temperatures from forty-one to forty-three degrees, with precipitation remaining unlikely. Monday night will be mostly clear across the region, with lows dropping to between twenty-six and thirty-one degrees and no precipitation expected.
